results.detail: server half exercised via the firmware's own upload route: one session, one object, terminal=done. Recording on the device, Web review and PDF export are not automatable here.

results.title: Session metadata, timestamp, time-zone, device association
Time zone, DST transition, device clock skew
results.detail: the upload API carries NO client timestamp — created_at is the database's own UTC default, so a wrong recorder clock cannot skew stored time (observed skew 15s). DST is not representable: storage is UTC throughout.

results.title: Older app/firmware version against current backend
results.detail: /sessions/raw (the pre-chunking upload path, no `total`, no `flags`) is still accepted by device-api v21+ → HTTP 200. Legacy firmware keeps uploading.

results.title: Duplicate AI callback or duplicate result submission
results.detail: replayed the identical take: HTTP 200 id=s-918e347a idempotent=True; rows for session 95 = 1

results.title: Signed audio/report URL expiry and sharing
results.detail: audio route → HTTP 302 redirect to a signed URL expiring in 3599s (1 h policy); tampered signature → HTTP 400

results.title: Role-based access to review, edit, export, retry, administration
results.detail: admin caller: /admin/status=200 /admin/users=200 /admin/devices=200, POST /firmware=400 (reaches validation, as an admin should); non-admin caller: /admin/status=403 POST /firmware=403

results.title: Manual reprocess after final processing failure
results.detail: retry on a non-error session → HTTP 409; after forcing error → retry HTTP 200, status now processing, attempts reset to 1; audit rows for this session=1 (previous_error preserved=True)

guard.error: Only a failed session can be retried

results.title: Manual Retry tapped while automatic retry is already running
results.detail: POST /sessions/:id/retry is refused unless status=='error' → HTTP 409. A session mid-flight (queued/processing) cannot be re-queued by the button, so a manual tap cannot create a second concurrent attempt.

body.error: Only a failed session can be retried
